# AI usage

This repository was built with Claude Code (an AI coding agent) driving the terminal, working from `SPECS.md` and `CLAUDE.md`.

**How it was used:** scaffolding, the Go/Temporal/SvelteKit/React/Terraform code, scripts and docs were generated by the agent in small steps and committed with Conventional Commits.

**How output was reviewed and tested:**

- Every layer has an automated test (Temporal `testsuite`, sqlc integration against Postgres, Vitest for one Svelte and one React component, a Playwright end-to-end story). `scripts/test-all.sh` and CI run them.
- Behaviour was verified against the running stack (curl against the Connect API, Playwright screenshots, the Temporal UI); the `proof/` folder records the results.
- Generated code (`gen/`) comes from `buf generate`; CI fails when it drifts.
- Infrastructure was applied with Terraform, smoke-tested in the cloud and destroyed with a verification script; no secrets are committed.
- Judgement calls are logged in `docs/DECISIONS.md` and `docs/adr/`.
